claim: On 2023-09-28 the Amazon MSK guide added Amazon MSK Replicator, a new feature that you can use to replicate data between Amazon MSK clusters.
question: Since when does Amazon MSK have a built-in feature to replicate data between clusters?

values.display: replicate data between Amazon MSK clusters

note: The change feed dates the What's New post of MSK Replicator to 2023-10-18. Older exam questions may suggest MirrorMaker for cross-cluster replication.
